description: Web Application for Visualization of LEAP-2022 Centrifuge Data and their Comparisons with User-Generated Numerical Simulations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Majid Manzari, George Washington University (gwu.edu). This project provides a web application created using a Python-based code to visualize the results of centrifuge tests conducted as part of LEAP-GWU-2022 (See the link to the data in Related Data and Software). The web application prompts the user to select a participating university and one of the centrifuge tests conducted at that university. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fpkz-tz94. Keywords: Python code, centrifuge data, visualizations, liquefaction, sheet-pile wall, soil-structure interaction.. Published 2023-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
